title: Make Batch44 ShowFile byte-limit test resilient to suite Git contention
outcome: The byte-limit regression keeps exercising the production short bound where it matters while exact large-blob assertions use the repository-approved test process ceiling and remain deterministic under full-suite load.
acceptance: An uninterrupted dotnet test PhoenixCodeNav.sln -c Release --no-build --no-restore run passes.
ShowFileHonorsSmallBlobByteLimitWithoutReturningAPartialDecode still proves the small cap returns null without a partial decode and proves exact, cap+1, cap-1, and zero-byte boundaries.

completion.summary: Hardened Batch44's process-backed large-blob byte-boundary assertions against full-suite Git contention without changing production behavior or the short-timeout/zero-limit coverage.
